free_tier.stated: No storage quota published, because the product is not storage. The free Community edition is the self-hosted OSS runtime under Apache 2.0 with community-only support; the hosted Cloud tier is 'subscription and usage-based pricing with tiered plans'. The datasets it serves are 'free, ready-to-query sample datasets' hosted by Spice, not by you.

egress.terms: Usage-based on Cloud; unmetered only if you self-host and pay your own egress.

tooling: A SQL query endpoint over the Spice runtime, and a Data Connector model that federates to external sources. Self-hosting gives full control but on your own hardware.
chaining: None for capacity — the free tier is software, so the bytes land wherever you point it (S3, GCS, local). It is a query layer, and a useful one, but it multiplies nothing.
limits_note: fails-quota: no free hosted bytes at all. Per-app request rate limits exist on Cloud per the management API docs.

evidence.proved: opened: 'Free under Apache 2.0 with community-only support' (OSS) / 'Subscription and usage-based pricing with tiered plans' (Cloud) / Enterprise licensing; 'Single-node engine' for Community vs 'Multi-node with clustering' for Cloud.
surfaced: 'The Spice.ai Cloud Platform includes a comprehensive set of free, ready-to-query sample datasets' — read-only samples, not user hosting.
surfaced: 'Spice.ai OSS — the open-source Spice runtime. Self-hosted, free, Apache 2.0.'
